theme_and_concept.description: A highly professional, industry-level SaaS placement portal. Focuses on clarity, progressive disclosure for complex data, and a clean, trustworthy aesthetic. Uses a modular grid system (Bento Grids) with left-sidebar navigation.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The Technical Look) for dashboard. Expose the skeleton with subtle borders. 1px solid borders for cards, no drop shadows to maintain a clean SaaS look.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle border color darken/lighten, explicit text color changes.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for sticky headers. Light mode: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200/50. Dark mode: bg-slate-950/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-800/50. CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_layout: Left-sidebar + modular content area. Modified F-pattern reading flow. Sidebar should be collapsible.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Summary widgets span 1 col. Main charts span 2-3 cols.
grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: p-1, p-2, p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8).

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-md) with sharp interaction animations. Active state: scale-95.
components.cards: Flat, rectangular, 1px border. No shadows. Internal padding p-6. Use Shadcn Card heavily customized.
components.tables: Shadcn Table. Dense, left-aligned data. Use badges for status (Applied, Shortlisted, Selected).
components.charts: Shadcn Charts (Recharts). Line charts for placement trends, Bar charts for company hiring comparisons. Avoid pie charts unless strict binary data.
components.forms: Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Progressive disclosure for complex student profiles.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Transition transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease. Explicitly change text color on hover.
motion_and_interactions.entrance: Staggered fade-up for list items (jobs, drives).
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Smooth state changes for application status timeline.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure 4.5:1 for body text. Use APCA guidelines.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="apply-job-button"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: NOTE: You have .js files not .tsx files. You MUST adapt all Shadcn UI components and snippets to standard JavaScript (.jsx) rather than TypeScript. Remove all type annotations.
Install required dependencies: `yarn add lucide-react react-router-dom recharts framer-motion sonner clsx tailwind-merge`.
Install Shadcn UI components and configure them for JS usage (or manually copy and convert to .jsx).
Configure Tailwind with the specified color palette and font families (Outfit for headings, IBM Plex Sans for body).
Implement role-based routing (Student, Recruiter, Admin) with distinct dashboard layouts.
Do NOT use HTML `<select>` or `<input type="date">`. Use customized Shadcn equivalents.
Ensure the Dashboard uses a collapsible left sidebar pattern with a main content area.
For the Analytics pages, utilize Recharts to show placement stats, keeping to 3-5 core KPIs per view.
Implement light/dark mode toggle using a standard theme provider.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use the specified font pairings and color archetypes.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully on sticky headers only. No completely transparent backgrounds.
Do NOT apply `transition: all`. Use specific properties like `transition-transform` or `transition-colors`.
Do NOT center align the app container. Text should be left-aligned for readability.
Use modern button styles. Pills or sharp elements.
Never use placeholder text or generic AI emojis for icons. Use Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus rings).
